title: String of Pearls ATC simulator representative schedule schema
description: One normalized representative-day schedule for a single supported airport

schemaVersion.description: Schedule contract version: version 1 contains sourced flight identity; version 2 contains airport-authored generated slots

profileType.description: Explicit profile semantics for version 2 schedules

airportIcao.description: ICAO identifier of the schedule airport in uppercase

timezone.description: IANA time zone name for the airport's local scheduledTime values
timezone.$comment: The asset validator resolves this value through Intl.DateTimeFormat and fails on unknown zones.

sampleDate.description: Representative day or profile anchor date, as a real YYYY-MM-DD calendar date

flights.description: Deterministically ordered movements (by scheduledTime then id) for the representative day

name.description: Human-readable name of the data source

url.description: URL the data was obtained from

retrievedAt.description: When the data was retrieved or reviewed

license.description: License or usage terms for the data

coverage.description: Honest description of what the data does and does not cover

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the schedule

category.description: Whether the movement arrives at or departs from the schedule airport

scheduledTime.description: Local HH:mm time of the movement

observedFlight.description: A sourced movement with normalized operating identity and route endpoints

authoredSlot.description: A representative local slot mapped to one reviewed airport-authored spawn pattern; identity and route endpoints are generated by that pattern

spawnPatternKey.description: Stable key of the exact airport-authored spawn pattern
